messages:
alice: Heads-up — staging preflight is failing repeatedly, blocking the release window. I see a bunch of jobs stuck in the preflight queue with docker pulls getting 429s from the registry.

deploy-bot: [CI] job staging-preflight/validate-image-graph #472 failed — exit 1. Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/472 :rotating_light:

dmitri: Ack. Saw the same. Multiple ephemeral runners queued, then the registry started returning rate-limit errors around 1709987600.

carla: Is this the external registry quota we've hit before or something new? Any recent parallelism changes in the pipeline?

alice: No config changes on our side; looks like a burst of parallel image pulls from different CI shards. One snippet from the runner logs:

```
Failed to pull image "gcr.io/redwood/staging:canary-20240321-58": GET https://gcr.io/v2/: received status 429 Too Many Requests
Retries exhausted after 5 attempts
```

infra-bot: Alert: Container registry rate limit exceeded (code 429). Affected projects: redwood/staging. Suggested mitigation: reduce parallel pulls or use mirrored cache.

dmitri: We can temporarily pin the promotion to the last-green image and skip the staging-preflight step to unblock the release, but that reduces safety. Seeking opinions.

eva: If we skip preflight we risk regressions — I'd prefer to hold the window for 30m and try mirror/cached pulls first. Can infra spin up a pull cache in the eu-west nodepool?

carla: +1 to mirror cache. Also, what about rate-limiting our job runner concurrency for the preflight job only? Quick patch to the pipeline: set matrix.concurrency=2 for staging-preflight.

dmitri: I can push a gating change to the release job to set concurrency=2 and add exponential backoff on pulls. But that will take ~10m to land and another 5-10m to propagate.

alice: Sounds good. Plan: (1) dont-promote: hold manual promotion for the release window, (2) dmitri pushes concurrency limiter & backoff, (3) infra attempts mirrored pull via temporary registry-cache on eu-west, (4) if still failing by +30m -> pin to last-green and notify PMs.

deploy-bot: [CI] queued: staging-preflight/validate-image-graph (#473) — concurrency override applied by dmitri.

infra-bot: Action: Created ephemeral pull cache at cache-ews-03 (mirror of gcr.io). TTL 1h. Route for CI runners updated.

carla: Nice. Monitor the queue and test flakiness. If preflight passes on the mirror, we can proceed with normal promote.

alice: I'll update release notes & the change window in the ticket: "Hold - registry throttling; mitigation in progress; manual promotion paused." Tagging @pm for awareness. :spiral_note_pad:

eva: Thanks everyone. If we hit pin threshold, I'll coordinate rollback notes & customer comms.

deploy-bot: [CI] staging-preflight/validate-image-graph (#473) succeeded on mirror — all green.

alice: Great — unhold for promotion in 5m after final smoke. Leaving this thread open for 30m for post-promote checks.
